text:
fiona: Legal wants us to stop using 'data residency' and 'sovereignty' in public docs. New approved terms: 'in-country data hosting' and 'regional availability'. Can someone take a quick sweep of affected pages and examples (FR/CA/HK)?

raj: Ill sweep the markdown and update the region matrix. Found 6 pages referencing old wording.

emily: Ill update SDK snippets (node, python) and add a go example for parity. Will include a clear note: 'Hosted routing hints vs Dedicated/Private controls.'

doc-bot: Linter run queued for PR after edits.

fiona: Please add link to internal phrasing guide in PR: https://internal.redwood/legal/region-phrasing. Also add i18n-needed: fr label.

emily: Quick cURL demo to include:
`curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/responses -H "Authorization: Bearer $API_KEY" -H "X-Redwood-Region: eu-west-1" -d '{"model":"redwood/gpt-large","input":"test"}'`

raj: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/9921 (WIP). Includes wording swaps, SDK snippets, and a short 'how routing works' block.

doc-bot: CI: staging build started for PR #9921.

translation-queue: i18n task accepted for FR/FR-CA. ETA 48h.

fiona: Great. Once translations land and CI passes, merge and post a one-line note in #general.
